sources.title: RadixArk Open-Sources DaisyRose-27B Agent Model Trained in 18 Days
sources.snippet: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, its first model, post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B with reinforcement learning on long-horizon agent tasks using only 1,200 curated tasks across 144 H200 GPUs in 18 days. Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 rose from 5.6% to 12.0%, with checkpoints released under Apache 2.0.

sources.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
sources.snippet: RadixArk trained DaisyRose-27B with Miles, our open-source reinforcement learning framework for large-scale model post-training, in fully asynchronous mode: the agent keeps working while the model learns, and neither waits for the other. While 128 H200s run the inference on agent tasks, 16 more run the trainer and learn from the trajectories.
